acceptance.basis: Unchanged engineering completeness/coverage/ATE/RPE limits from the previous plane study. Fixed before first image-tracking/PnP fitting; not publisher accuracy requirements or physical calibration guarantees.

calibration.axes: x right, y down, z forward
calibration.basis: Publisher recommends ROS default intrinsics without undistortion for pre-registered PNG depth. Depth is already rescaled and expressed in RGB optical coordinates; apply no extra correction or IR-to-RGB transform. This is the recommended approximation, not newly measured calibration.

dense_fitting_model.arithmetic: native f64; no external binary or bitwise-equivalence claim
dense_fitting_model.final_statistics: original raw full-resolution images; original bilinear final admission, count/fraction/error gates

gradient.depth_nonfinite: replace each nonfinite derivative with zero
gradient.jacobian: local Sobel surrogate; not an exact derivative of the discontinuous rounded-pixel objective

intensity_normalization.admission: minimum count and finite positive means/gains before mutation

dense_fitting_model.iterations: all scheduled updates; no epsilon early exit

lookup.coordinate: trunc(projected_coordinate + 0.5); test finite and signed bounds before usize cast
lookup.depth: selected target depth finite and original metric difference gate
lookup.point: finite transformed point with positive z
lookup.uniqueness: one row per valid source pixel; no target uniqueness claim

dense_fitting_model.ownership: borrowed native input; owned Python input copies before GIL release; explicit CPU/device transfers
dense_fitting_model.pose_update: existing native f64 proper left Rodrigues update and solver

pyramid.dimensions: floor(width/2), floor(height/2); all scheduled levels at least 3x3
pyramid.intrinsics: halve fx, fy, cx, cy per level

working_bytes.excludes: caller inputs/Python input copies, allocator metadata, stacks
working_bytes.meaning: both fitting pyramids; both raw levels; max of four current-level target gradient planes and two temporary smoothing planes; ordered reductions or nonconcurrent 6x6 matrix, RHS and solution scratch

dense_support_policy: Minimum count and a nonsingular system for initial/intermediate hypotheses; the unchanged 0.5 full-resolution correspondence fraction applies to the returned pose. The independent full-cloud support and complete trajectory accuracy gates are unchanged.
generation: Every original adjacent RGB-D frame with the frozen rounded-sobel native candidate; identity then preceding returned increment; no reference, rescale, retry, reset or selection.

candidate.selection_basis: Choose the existing complete native variant before any new archive payload, image or reference read. The current rpy ATE 0.10032699404221075m still fails; selection is a diagnostic candidate, not deployment acceptance.

native_refinement_policy: No estimator, preprocessing, sampling, gradients, solver, pose update or production/native dependency change. Freeze both full timelines before either score. Original complete-row, raw-final, world/full-cloud/IO and accuracy requirements remain fixed.
scope: Two previously unscored recordings under the same Freiburg 1 registered-depth convention. No independent hardware/scene, physical calibration, speed or complete operational 80% claim. Both recordings become observed after this run; do not retune and call them held out again.
